body: Founder, live, real-time: 'almost all of the pages in fatbaby news site from the header are stale' -> 'theres like 3 different live feeds and none of them work' -> 'all the governance stuff stale' -> 'front page stale' -> 'front page needs whole rework'. Root cause: WriteSignals/FlushNodes/FlushEdges/FlushAuditors/PublishObservation all sat behind 'if processed > 0' in cmd/entity-graph/main.go's runBatch, but processed only counts genuinely new 8-K filings parsed that specific batch. ScoreLongTenure (runs against the full graph every tick, not just new records) and everything cascading from it (governance_health, decay, board_decay_concern) compute real signals every batch regardless -- any batch whose new records weren't a fresh 8-K silently discarded all of that computed output. Confirmed live before the fix: a real batch logged fresh 'governance_health ticker=BA score=0.000' lines, cursor genuinely advanced, and NONE of it reached signals.ndjson on disk. Last real write before this fix: 2026-07-31 -- five days of newssite's /section/governance, /live, /breaking, and front-page ticker-tape (all reading the same signals.ndjson via a 30s-refreshed in-memory store) faithfully re-rendering genuinely stale data. The process never tripped any watchdog: cursor kept advancing (saveCursor is unconditional) and the checkpoint-freshness DBs kept touching 'fresh' every 30s via a separate, earlier code path (touchFilingIndexSnapshot/touchAccuracyIndexSnapshot), a real blind spot in the Phase 3 freshness watchdog built earlier this session. Fix: split the flush gate -- FlushNodes/FlushEdges/FlushAuditors (full-graph redump, no diffing) stay behind processed>0 to avoid unbounded duplicate growth; WriteSignals (appends only this batch's own output, already-accepted repeat-write shape) now fires whenever len(allSignals)>0, independent of processed. New regression test TestRunBatch_WritesSignalsEvenWithoutANew8K reproduces the exact shape (one non-8-K record + a long-tenured-director graph) and was verified to actually catch the bug (fails pre-fix via git stash, passes post-fix). go test ./... clean. Live-deployed (service restarted with the fix); full live reconfirmation still pending real new filing/PR data to trigger the next batch (nothing arrived in the ~20 minutes since deploy, unrelated to the fix -- normal real-world data cadence). Commits 33d7904 (fix) + 74f1df2 (changelog).
title: entity-graph: stop discarding freshly-computed signals when no new 8-K arrived (newssite staleness root cause)
